title: Added new Animate with Text tool to our plugin for Aseprite, Pixelorama and online editor
author: Kaninen_Ka9en
selftext: It supports up to 128x128 images, you can use it to generate characters, VFX, scenery and much more

comments.author: odragora
comments.body:
Very cool!

I wonder if it can do something like animations in Flashback (https://www.dosgames.com/game/flashback-the-quest-for-identity/).

It was rotoscope-animated, but still pixel-art.

replies.author: Cool-Chemical-5629
replies.body: Oh I remember playing Flashback when I was a kid. Oh boy did I get pissed when I got far and then lost. Those young gamers will never know that feeling with all the checkpoints in modern games. 😂

replies.author: odragora
replies.body:
It was an entire journey every time!

I'm so glad the roguelike genre got popular and I can have a similar experience in games again.

replies.author: morewordsfaster
replies.body: Flashback and Another World/Out of this World are my ideal pixel art style for my current project and I'm having the worst time trying to nail it.

comments.author: littleredscar
comments.body: I think a useful feature for me would be: given a sprite animation for a move/skill, generate the same animation for the character but with different equipment on. This had been a bottleneck in the industry for sprite based 2D games. you can't really change the appearance of your character when you change their equipments

replies.author: mike402
replies.body: At Ludo.ai we have a sprite “motion transfer” tool to do exactly this
